scripts.build: bun run --filter '@qrcc/wasm' build && bun run --filter '@qrcc/api' build && bun run --filter '@qrcc/web' build
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter '@qrcc/wasm' build:types && bun run --filter '@qrcc/web' gen && tsc --build && tsc -p apps/web --noEmit
scripts.check: bun run fmt:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run lint:html && bun run rust:fmt:check && bun run rust:lint
scripts.postinstall: bun install --cwd tools/markuplint --frozen-lockfile || bun install --cwd tools/markuplint
scripts.test:all: bun run test && bun run e2e
scripts.clean: find . -maxdepth 3 -name node_modules -type d -prune -exec rm -rf {} + && bun install
